name: GEF Small Grants Programme Turkmenistan
summary: Turkmenistan's GEF Small Grants country programme, run by CEPF, taking letters of inquiry from civil society organisations based in the country for community-based management of threatened ecosystems and species.

amount.note: Regular SGP grants; a lower limit may be set for individual calls

status.quote: The Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF) is currently accepting Letters of Inquiry (LOIs) from civil society organizations based in Turkmenistan for projects under the Global Environment Facility (GEF) Small Grants Program (SGP).

deadline.quote: Turkmenistan Call for Letters of Inquiry for the GEF Small Grants Program Closes Tuesday, December 8, 2026.
